claims.label: Lindsey Graham RJC Statement on Anti-Israel Disqualification
claims.claim: Lindsey Graham stated at the Republican Jewish Coalition that anti-Israel rhetoric is "not the road to being elected as a Republican" and that one "can't even have an anti-Israel thought."
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the full RJC transcript or video to confirm exact wording, context, and whether the statement was made in a public or closed session.

claims.label: Randy Fine Calls Tucker Carlson "Most Dangerous Anti-Semite"
claims.claim: Randy Fine stated on stage at the Republican Jewish Coalition that "Tucker Carlson is the most dangerous anti-Semite in America" and accused him of taking on the mantle of "leader of a modern-day Hitler youth."
claims.investigative_direction: Verify the full RJC recording for the complete quote and any surrounding context.

claims.label: Host Characterizes Graham's RJC Statement as Hostile Messaging
claims.claim: Host characterizes Lindsey Graham's RJC statement as "great messaging" sarcastically, asserting it constitutes hostile messaging directed at American voters who hold anti-Israel views.
claims.investigative_direction: This is host concurrence / interpretive stance; verification requires only that A-1313.1 captures the original statement.

claims.label: Ben Shapiro Accuses Tucker Carlson of Knifing Charlie Kirk
claims.claim: Ben Shapiro stated that Tucker Carlson "knifes [friends] directly between the shoulder blades when convenient for him" and specifically "preys on the friendship he proclaims" with Charlie Kirk.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify by reviewing Ben Shapiro's full segment; assess the framing in light of host's counter-evidence (Joe Rogan clip, photo, and claimed text messages).

claims.label: Ben Shapiro Quotes Charlie Kirk Calling Nick Fuentes "Vermin"
claims.claim: Ben Shapiro stated that "Charlie believed that Nick Fuentes was vermin. That's a direct quote."
claims.investigative_direction: Locate the underlying Charlie Kirk statement Ben Shapiro cites to verify the attribution and original context.

claims.label: Candace Owens "Hall Monitor" Joke on Joe Rogan (2018)
claims.claim: In a 2018 Joe Rogan appearance, Candace Owens referred to him as "the hall monitor" and joked that he "writes you a pink slip" and sends people to "Saturday school."
claims.investigative_direction: Verify by locating the full original Joe Rogan episode to confirm wording and date.

claims.label: Photo of Candace and Charlie Kirk Puffing Chests at Ben Shapiro's Studio
claims.claim: A photo displayed in the episode depicts Candace Owens and Charlie Kirk in Ben Shapiro's Sherman Oaks studio, standing with puffed chests and standing extra tall, taken in or around June 2018 after they were booked on his show despite prior tension.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify by locating the source image metadata (date, location, producer of the appearance).

claims.label: Israeli War Room Reports Erika Kirk Will Accept Pillars of Jerusalem Award
claims.claim: The Israeli War Room X account posted that "Miss Erika / Mrs. Erika Kirk will accept the award on her husband's behalf" at Israel's 2025 Christian Media Summit, citing Jerusalem Post reporting by Michael Starr, with the Pillars of Jerusalem Award to be presented by Douglas Murray, Yael Eckstein, and Dr. Jürgen Bühler.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify by independently locating the original Jerusalem Post article by Michael Starr, the Israeli War Room X post, and the Christian Media Summit program to confirm whether the award and presenters are real and whether Erika Kirk is listed.

claims.label: Andrew Kolvet Denies Knowledge of Award
claims.claim: TPUSA spokesperson Andrew Kolvet posted on X that "this is the first we're hearing of this" regarding the reported Pillars of Jerusalem Award, and stated TPUSA had reached out to Michael Starr for a correction.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify by locating Kolbenschlag's original X post and any subsequent follow-up from TPUSA.

claims.label: Michael Starr Acknowledges Israeli Government Press Office "Wavered"
claims.claim: Michael Starr posted on X that "the Israeli government press office wavered on claims that Erika Kirk would be accepting [the posthumous award]" after TPUSA said it was unaware of the award and that its CEO was not scheduled to participate.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify the original Michael Starr X post and corroborate with any subsequent Jerusalem Post correction or retraction.

claims.label: Erika Kirk Opposes Courtroom Camera Ban
claims.claim: In a preview clip of her Jesse Watters interview, Erika Kirk opposed the defense motion to ban cameras in the courtroom, stating "We deserve to have cameras in there … Let everyone see what true evil is."
claims.investigative_direction: Verify by reviewing the full Jesse Watters interview once aired and any subsequent court filings on the camera question.

claims.label: Kash Patel Posts X Defense of Girlfriend Alexis Wilkins
claims.claim: Kash Patel posted an extended X message defending his girlfriend Alexis Wilkins against criticism following reporting about his use of an FBI aircraft to travel to her events, asserting she is "a true patriot" and "country music sensation."
claims.investigative_direction: Verify by locating Patel's original X post, and corroborate against any reporting or inspector general review of his use of FBI aircraft for personal travel.

claims.label: Tom Paul Alleges Tyler Robinson and Crooks Test Score Pattern
claims.claim: A viewer (Tom Paul) alleged in a YouTube comment that Tyler Robinson's ACT score was 34 (99th percentile), Thomas Matthew Crooks' SAT score was in the 99th percentile, and that this pattern resembles Adam Lanza, suggesting a common playbook.
claims.investigative_direction: Independently confirm the test scores from public records; assess whether any reporting substantiates a "playbook" pattern.

claims.label: Petal Requests Clarification on Candace's Degree
claims.claim: A viewer (Petal) commented asking Candace Owens to clarify whether she holds a degree, noting that some people claim she does not.
claims.investigative_direction: No investigative direction required – viewer question is recorded as artifact.

claims.label: TB Comments on Charlie Kirk's Open-Exchange Values
claims.claim: A viewer (TB) commented that being exposed to all perspectives with the right to respectfully disagree is what Charlie Kirk stood for, and that "anyone who is divisive over this right is fake and gay" (per the host's reported phrasing).
claims.investigative_direction: No investigative direction required – viewer comment is recorded as artifact.

claims.label: Host Characterizes Ben Shapiro Segment as Scripted Stab
claims.claim: Host characterizes Ben Shapiro's segment attacking Tucker Carlson as "a very, dare I say, scripted stab" that "took" the same talking points as other Zionists.
claims.investigative_direction: This is a host interpretive stance; verification is anchored to A-1314.1.

claims.label: Host Says Randy Fine Called Palestinians Not Truly Human and AIPAC Dropped Him
claims.claim: The host says Randy Fine has said essentially that Palestinians are not truly human and that even AIPAC had to drop him.
claims.investigative_direction: Locate Fine's original statements and any AIPAC statement ending its support to confirm both parts.
claims.transcript_snippet: Randy Fine, just to be clear, he has been so disgusting in his rhetoric towards Palestinians, saying essentially that they're just not even truly humans. That even AIPAC had to drop him.

claims.label: Host Says Interns Printed Red Tucker Is Not Maga Signs
claims.claim: The host says interns were apparently sent to a print shop to print red signs reading "Tucker Carlson is not Maga" for the Republican Jewish Coalition event.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain event photos or video of the signs and identify who produced and distributed them.
claims.transcript_snippet: It looks like they sent some poor interns down to FedEx or Kinko's or UPS to print out these totally organic red signs.

claims.label: Host Says Signs Were Handed to Young Men to Wave While Fine Spoke
claims.claim: The host says the printed signs were given to young men who were instructed to wave them on stage while Randy Fine spoke.
claims.investigative_direction: Review RJC event footage for the sign holders and ask organizers who instructed them.
claims.transcript_snippet: And they instructed them to wave the posters on stage while Randy Fine, of all people, spoke.

claims.label: Host Says Attacks on Tucker Were Instructed and Inorganic, Like Operation Mocking Pastor
claims.claim: The host says the identical anti-Tucker messaging shows it is inorganic and compares it to Operation Mocking Pastor, saying it was clear the speakers were instructed to go after Tucker Carlson.
claims.investigative_direction: Compare the wording of the anti-Tucker statements across speakers and identify any shared script or coordinating source.
claims.transcript_snippet: And they all say the same thing, which shows how inorganic it is. It's like Operation Mocking Pastor. And it was very clear that they were instructed to go after Tucker.

claims.label: Host Says Randy Fine Called Palestinians Subhuman and Laughed at a Dead Body
claims.claim: The host says Randy Fine came out with genocidal language against Palestinians, referred to them as subhuman, and laughed when he saw a dead body of a Palestinian.
claims.investigative_direction: Locate Fine's posts or remarks calling Palestinians subhuman and any video of him laughing at a body.
claims.transcript_snippet: like Randy Fine just come right out with genocidal language against the Palestinians, uh referring to them as subhuman, laughing when he sees a dead body of a Palestinian.

claims.label: Host Says Tucker Was Fired From Fox for Opposing the Ukraine War
claims.claim: The host says Fox fired Tucker Carlson because he was speaking out against the Ukrainian war, which she says was not allowed.
claims.investigative_direction: Fox News termination statements, court filings from the Dominion matter and reporting on the stated reason for Carlson's exit.
claims.transcript_snippet: That's also why they fired him from Fox because um he was speaking out against the Ukrainian war and that was not allowed.

claims.label: Host Says Same Individuals Were Squeezing Charlie Over Tucker Before His Death
claims.claim: The host says that, as she proved, the same individuals now attacking Tucker were squeezing Charlie Kirk leading up to the end of his life and wanted Tucker barred from the Turning Point USA stage.
claims.investigative_direction: Locate the donor and activist messages to Kirk about Tucker Carlson's speaking slot and identify the senders.
claims.transcript_snippet: We all know, as I proved, that these same individuals were squeezing Charlie Kirk leading up to the end of his life.

claims.label: Host Says Critics Call Tucker Interviewing Fuentes a Betrayal of Charlie
claims.claim: The host says that Tucker Carlson interviewed Nick Fuentes, and that the same people who pressured Charlie Kirk now assert posthumously that the interview was a betrayal of Charlie and ended their friendship.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify the specific statements asserting the Fuentes interview betrayed Kirk and their dates.
claims.transcript_snippet: they've now decided to besmirch Charlie's name by asserting that Tucker interviewing Nick Fuentes is a betrayal to Charlie.

claims.label: Host Says She Interviewed Fuentes in July and Charlie Never Objected
claims.claim: The host says she interviewed Nick Fuentes shortly before Charlie died, discussed the interview with Charlie, and he never told her not to speak to Fuentes or called it a betrayal.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the Owens–Kirk messages about the Fuentes interview and the interview date; the transcript's "died in July" appears garbled.
claims.transcript_snippet: Before Charlie died, really kind of just before he died in July, I interviewed Nick Fuentes. And Charlie and I discussed the interview uh and never once did he tell me not to speak to Nick Fuentes.

claims.label: Host Says She Urged Charlie and Kolvet That Charlie Host and Debate Fuentes
claims.claim: The host says she separately told both Charlie and Andrew Kolvet that Charlie should host Nick Fuentes and debate him, that she tried to make it happen, and that Kolvet can confirm this.
claims.investigative_direction: Ask Kolvet to confirm the conversation and look for related messages or scheduling attempts.
claims.transcript_snippet: I also had a long discussion with Andrew Kolvet that separately, telling them both that Charlie should host Nick Fuentes on his show and debate him. I tried to make that happen.

claims.label: Shapiro Says Tucker Is a Coward and Fuentes Correctly Said So
claims.claim: In the segment the host plays, Ben Shapiro says Tucker Carlson is a coward and that his relationship with Nick Fuentes begins with Fuentes correctly pointing that out.
claims.investigative_direction: Review Shapiro's full segment for the exact wording and sourcing.
claims.transcript_snippet: Tucker Carlson, you see, is a coward. And here is where his relationship with Nick Fuentes begins.

claims.label: Shapiro Says Tucker Gave Owens Ideological Laundering Services
claims.claim: In the segment the host plays, Ben Shapiro says Tucker Carlson had Candace Owens on a few weeks earlier to treat her to his usual ideological laundering services.
claims.investigative_direction: Review Shapiro's full segment to confirm the quote and its context.
claims.transcript_snippet: Tucker Carlson a few weeks back had on Candace Owens to treat her to his usual ideological laundering services.

claims.label: Shapiro Segment Clip Has Owens Saying JFK and 9/11 Were Convenient for Israel
claims.claim: The clip of the host that Shapiro airs in his segment has her saying it was convenient for Israel that JFK got shot and convenient when the towers went down; the host does not dispute the clip's wording.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify the original episode from which Shapiro excerpted the clip.
claims.transcript_snippet: And then but it was just convenient for Israel that uh JFK got shot. It was just convenient, you guys. Totally convenient. It was convenient for Israel, by the way, when the towers went down.

claims.label: Shapiro Segment Clip Has Owens Saying Pedophiles Are Intentionally in Power
claims.claim: The clip aired in Shapiro's segment has the host saying pedophiles are literally in power intentionally so they can be controlled, and that many were themselves raped as children.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify the original source episode of the excerpt and any support the host offered for it there.
claims.transcript_snippet: I'm waking people up to the fact that pedophiles are in power. They're literally in power. And that is intentional because then they can be controlled while they are in power.

claims.label: Shapiro Segment Clip Has Owens Saying Macron Is Married to a Trans Man Who Molested Him
claims.claim: The clip aired in Shapiro's segment has the host listing Trudeau, Obama, Zelensky and Macron as gay and saying Macron is married to a trans man who molested him as a child; she says afterward, "fact check all true."
claims.investigative_direction: Identify the original source episode; Macron legal filings and public records on the claims about Brigitte Macron.
claims.transcript_snippet: Emmanuel Macron, gay and married to a trans man who molested him when he was a child.

claims.label: Host Stands by Clips and Says to Blame Zionists if She Dies Mysteriously
claims.claim: The host says Shapiro used out-of-context clips and that she stands by her perspectives, including that dinosaur bones are usually found by experts, and says that if she winds up dead in mysterious circumstances people should assume Zionists orchestrated it.
claims.investigative_direction: Compare the full original clips with Shapiro's excerpts.
claims.transcript_snippet: And yes, if I wind up dead in mysterious circumstances, you should obviously assume it was orchestrated by Zionists.

claims.label: Host Says Emma Goldman and Freud Brought Feminism and Modern Psychology to America
claims.claim: The host says that feminism and modern psychology were brought to and fought for on American shores by people like Emma Goldman and Sigmund Freud.
claims.investigative_direction: Historical record on Goldman's and Freud's activities; this is the host's sweeping characterization of a group's role.
claims.transcript_snippet: people like Emma Goldman on feminism. Sigmund Freud, the father of modern psychology.

claims.label: Host Says Adelson Gambling Empire and Sackler Pharmaceuticals Came From the Same Group
claims.claim: The host says the gambling empire is where the Adelson empire wealth comes from and that many pharmaceuticals came from people like the Sackler family.
claims.investigative_direction: Corporate and philanthropic records on the Adelson and Sackler fortunes.
claims.transcript_snippet: The gambling empire uh is where the Adelson empire wealth comes from. Uh as are many pharmaceuticals like the Sackler family.

claims.label: Host Says Sackler Names Are on Buildings in Tel Aviv
claims.claim: The host says the Sackler family have their names on buildings in Tel Aviv and that they are the owners of Purdue Pharma, the architects of the opioid epidemic.
claims.investigative_direction: Public records of Sackler-named buildings in Tel Aviv and Purdue Pharma ownership and litigation settlements.
claims.transcript_snippet: These people have their have their names on buildings in Tel Aviv. The owners of Purdue Pharma, the architects of the opioid epidemic.

claims.label: Host Quotes Al Goldstein on Why Jews Are in Pornography
claims.claim: The host quotes Al Goldstein as having notoriously said the only reason Jews are in pornography is that they think Christ sucks and that pornography defiles Christian culture, and says Goldstein was right.
claims.investigative_direction: Locate the original Al Goldstein interview or publication containing the quoted words.
claims.transcript_snippet: He's the one who notoriously said, "The only reason that Jews are in pornography is that we think Christ sucks. Catholicism sucks.

claims.label: Host Says Samuel Roth Fought for Pornography Free-Speech Ruling
claims.claim: The host says pornography became considered free speech because Jewish individuals in America fought for that, naming Samuel Roth, who she says fought for the decision in court.
claims.investigative_direction: Court record of Roth v. United States and Roth's role in it.
claims.transcript_snippet: That's because Jewish individuals in America fought for that. Samuel Roth, actually.

claims.label: Host Says Magnus Hirschfeld Is the Origin of Transgenderism
claims.claim: The host says that if one traces where transgenderism came from, Magnus Hirschfeld was the doctor and sexologist behind it.
claims.investigative_direction: Historical record of Hirschfeld's work; this is the host's attribution of a modern movement to one person.
claims.transcript_snippet: Transgenderism, go back and and try to figure out where that came from. Magnus Hirschfeld was the doctor and the sexologist.

claims.label: Shapiro Says Tucker Is the Most Virulent Super Spreader of Vile Ideas
claims.claim: Ben Shapiro says there is no question Tucker Carlson has become the most virulent super spreader of vile ideas in America and that those who oppose such ideas have every right to call him that.
claims.investigative_direction: Review Shapiro's full segment for context.
claims.transcript_snippet: There's no question that Tucker has become the most virulent super spreader of vile ideas in America.

claims.label: Shapiro Says Fuentes Dedicated His Life to Destroying Charlie and TPUSA From Inside
claims.claim: Ben Shapiro says Charlie Kirk believed Nick Fuentes was vermin because Fuentes dedicated his life to destroying Charlie Kirk and TPUSA from the inside.
claims.investigative_direction: Find the underlying Kirk statements about Fuentes that Shapiro relies on.
claims.transcript_snippet: He believed that because Nick Fuentes dedicated his life to destroying Charlie Kirk and TPUSA from the inside.

claims.label: Host Says Charlie and Shapiro Did Not Get Along Because Shapiro Hindered TPUSA Early
claims.claim: The host says Charlie and Ben Shapiro did not get along because Charlie found out Ben was operating behind the scenes to stop him and hinder the growth of Turning Point USA in its early days.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the Kirk–Owens messages the host cites and ask Shapiro or TPUSA of that era to respond.
claims.transcript_snippet: Charlie and Ben Shapiro did not get along uh because Charlie found out that Ben was operating behind the scenes to uh stop him and sort of hinder the growth of Turning Point USA in our early days

claims.label: Host Says She Has 80 to 150 Texts From Charlie About Shapiro
claims.claim: The host says she has only about 80 to 150 text messages from Charlie to that effect, calls it a fact rather than a debate, and says she will gladly share them if challenged.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain and authenticate the messages; the host has not displayed them.
claims.transcript_snippet: And I have only about 80 to 150 text messages from Charlie to that effect.
